bio.text: Butch Parrish (Larry J. Parrish) represents Georgia House District 158 and is serving his 20th term in the House.
Parrish was born in Swainsboro, Georgia, and holds a B.S. in Pharmacy from the University of Georgia.
Parrish served three terms on the Swainsboro City Council and owns Parrish Properties, a real estate holding company.
